# HTTP Basic auth behavior when a username:password is configured on the
# web interface control surface. Credentials are REDACTED - do not put real
# REAPER web-interface passwords in this repo. Tested live with real
# credentials in-session; only the response shapes are recorded here.

# request: GET /_/TRANSPORT with NO Authorization header
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Server:reaper_csurf_www/0.1
WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="reaper_www"
Content-length: 0
Connection: keep-alive

# request: GET /_/TRANSPORT with WRONG credentials (curl -u wronguser:wrongpass)
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Server:reaper_csurf_www/0.1
WWW-Authenticate: Basic realm="reaper_www"
Content-length: 0
Connection: keep-alive

# request: GET /_/TRANSPORT with CORRECT credentials (curl -u <redacted>:<redacted>)
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Server:reaper_csurf_www/0.1
Content-Type: text/plain
Cache-Control: no-cache, must-revalidate
Expires: Sat, 26 Jul 1997 05:00:00 GMT
Content-length: 42
Connection: keep-alive

TRANSPORT	0	1.045553	1	00:00:01:01	1.3.09
